# Data Source: yet_cloud_environment

An environment, by its name or its id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By its name…
data "yet_cloud_environment" "production" {
  name = "production"
}

# …or by its id.
data "yet_cloud_environment" "staging" {
  id = "env_1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Its id; or `name`.
- `name` (String) Its name; or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `aws_account_id` (String) The AWS account its applications' buckets are made in, if set.
- `color` (String) How Cloud draws it.
- `domain` (String) Where its applications answer.
- `functions` (List of String) The Lambda runtimes beside its runtimes its applications may run on as functions.
- `pool_id` (String) The pool it runs on, if on one.
- `prefix` (String) What goes before the zone's name.
- `runtime_id` (String) The runtime it runs on, if on one.
- `zone_id` (String) The DNS zone it answers in, if any.
